moves.note: Exit weak income, focus on safety

plan: Cut all leveraged ETFs to zero to eliminate extreme risk.
Sell all individual tech/chip names to reduce concentration.
Exit the downtrending QQQ and weak QQQI.
Trim SPY to 20% to build a cash buffer.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and low drawdowns.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and concentration, accepting lower potential gains for greater stability.

moves.note: Exit weak income, focus on growth

plan: Reduce concentration by trimming SPY and SMH.
Exit QQQI and QQQ to remove weak positions.
Maintain minimal exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL).
Add MSFU, a top scanner setup, for growth potential.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This plan targets ~2.5% monthly return by balancing risk reduction with growth. It trims concentrated and weak positions while adding a high-potential new name, maintaining a moderate risk profile.

moves.note: Exit weak income, focus on high growth

plan: Reduce SPY and SMH to allow concentration in top performers.
Exit QQQI and QQQ to remove underperforming assets.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for amplified gains.
Add MSFU, a high-scoring scanner setup, to capture upside.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by leaning into leverage and strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return, accepting significantly higher potential drawdowns and leverage decay. It concentrates capital in high-conviction, leveraged plays and strong scanner setups, requiring strict stop discipline.

plan: Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Exit QQQ and SMH to reduce volatility.
Significantly increase QQQI to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to maintain some broad market exposure while building cash.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation.
income.read: This plan targets ~1% monthly return focused on income generation and capital preservation. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-producing assets like QQQI, accepting lower growth potential for stability.
